page.overview:
Who is Arcana Force Extra - The Light Ruler?

Arcana Force Extra - The Light Ruler is a character version of the card, "Arcana Force Extra - The Light Ruler".

Arcana Force Extra - The Light Ruler appears in the video game, Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2008. it first appears as the third guardian of the temple and only allowed the player to go beyond if the player beat it in a duel in which the player has to win the duel with five or less cards in the deck. By beating it, the player can go to the fourth level of World five Order.

In World Championship 2008, Arcana Force Extra - The Light Ruler uses a Mill Deck titled "Nightsong Crush".
